about.title: Manhattan Beach Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: When a fatal collision happens on a corridor like Sepulveda Boulevard, Manhattan Beach Boulevard, Highland Avenue, or Rosecrans Avenue, the loss ripples through an entire family. While Manhattan Beach's most recent recorded year showed no traffic deaths alongside 102 injury collisions, any single fatal crash carries devastating weight for those left behind. California law allows a limited group of survivors — spouses, domestic partners, and children first, followed by certain dependents or heirs — to pursue a civil wrongful death claim separate from any criminal proceedings that may follow. Our team handles wrongful death claims and can explain standing, deadlines, and what losses may be recoverable. You shouldn't have to navigate a legal process alone while mourning someone you love. Reaching out costs nothing, and we work on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless a recovery is obtained.

about.ctaText: Contact us about your family's options — free and confidential.

items.title: Understanding Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to spouses, domestic partners, and children first, with other dependents or heirs eligible in certain situations. We can help clarify where your family fits before any claim moves forward.

items.title: A Firm Deadline That Doesn't Wait
items.desc: California generally gives two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death claim, and that window shrinks significantly if a government entity was involved. Contacting us early helps protect that timeline.

items.title: Losses Beyond the Obvious
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance — not just economic damages. We can walk your family through what may apply to your specific loss.

items.question: How long does my family have to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, California law allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death lawsuit. That timeline can be much shorter if a government agency or public roadway maintenance issue was involved, so it's worth speaking with us sooner rather than later.

items.question: Who in our family is allowed to bring a wrongful death claim?
items.answer: California law gives priority to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children. If none exist, certain other dependents or heirs may have standing. We can review your family's specific circumstances to determine who may file.

items.question: Several busy roads run through Manhattan Beach — does that affect our case?
items.answer: Corridors like Sepulveda Boulevard, Manhattan Beach Boulevard, Highland Avenue, and Rosecrans Avenue see a share of the city's recorded collisions, particularly around Tuesday afternoon peak hours. Where and when a crash happened can matter for gathering evidence, and we can look into the specific circumstances of your loss.

items.question: Is a wrongful death claim the same as a criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No, a wrongful death claim is a separate civil action focused on compensation for the surviving family, regardless of whether criminal charges are filed. The two proceedings can happen independently of one another, and we can explain how that separation may affect your situation.
